analysis_plan.outcome: A=1 iff recorded_verdict is pass; otherwise 0 for the three explicit non-pass labels only
analysis_plan.zero_does_not_mean: mathematically incorrect, failed semantic examination, or a rejected decision
estimands: mean of task-specific mean edge differences
analysis_plan.reference_null: E_task[mean_edge(A_after-A_before)]=0 in a hypothetical independent exchangeable task-generating population with the same selection mechanism
analysis_plan.inference_status: conditional exploratory reference; task independence and transportability are unverified
analysis_plan.t_tests: one two-sided paired t-test on task-level before/after means for each of three declared routes; no edge-level t-test
analysis_plan.bootstrap: uniform task-cluster resampling with replacement; retain all selected task edges, same indices for before/after; percentile 95% intervals
analysis_plan.multiplicity: all three reference p-values reported; no confirmatory family or significance-based selection; intervals are pointwise
additional_descriptions: recorded field comparisons and unknown check extent

source_verification_scope: Original source hashes recorded at freeze; portable runtime verifies frozen projections, not unavailable full originals

context_diagnostics.confidence_selection_diagnostic_timing: added after primary estimates to explain inherited selection; descriptive only, no added test or interval
context_diagnostics.review_completion_time: not established by these projection tables
context_diagnostics.cross_task_independence_blocks: not available in this projection; no block-robust inference attempted

task_difference_diagnostics.exact_t_normality_assumption: not met literally: bounded discrete task differences; t is a large-task-sample approximation conditional on task independence

structure.interpretation: Shared interior endpoints cancel algebraically. More edges in a chain do not provide that many independent net-improvement observations. These diagnostic chains do not redefine stage-7 episodes.
